subject: Co-sell demo: Stratus Systems x Redwood — joint runbook & final time?
content:
From: Amit Shah <amit@stratus-systems.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@stratus-systems.com
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + Stratus joint demo — proposed windows

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the intro last week — the buyer at NebulaWorks (CTO + two platform SREs) wants to see a joint technical demo focused on multi-cloud inference latency and autoscaling. They asked for an interactive session with an SI engineer present for architecture Q&A.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Wed Oct 11, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Oct 12, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Oct 13, 08:00–09:00 (tight window)

If none of these work, can you share a couple of alternatives next week? I attached a short note with the buyer's priority list. Also looping Lina (SI lead) to confirm availability.

Best,
Amit
[Attachment: nebula-priorities.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)]

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@stratus-systems.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Stratus joint demo — proposed windows

Amit — thanks, this is helpful. All three slots are plausible but we need to lock an SI engineer and a Redwood tech lead. My suggestions:

- Primary: Thu Oct 12, 14:00–15:00 PDT (works best for our EU SI coverage too)
- Fallback: Wed Oct 11, 10:00–11:00 PDT

Action items for us before final calendar invite:
1) Confirm Lina (SI) availability — @Lina, can you confirm?
2) Confirm Redwood TL: I propose Karthik as TL for the session and Vanessa as ops contact for runbook/host failover.
3) Share a one-page runbook and a short demo brief (attached draft).

I've attached a draft runbook and a short demo brief, and I'll send an invite once we have confirmations. If NebulaWorks needs additional compliance screening (log retention question), loop in Kim — she can answer retention/SLA questions during the call.

Thanks — Soojin

[Attachment: runbook-draft.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-demo-brief.md (MD, 3 KB)]

---

From: Lina Torres <lina@stratus-systems.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@stratus-systems.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@stratus-systems.com
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Stratus joint demo — proposed windows

Hi Amit / Soojin — Lina here. I can do Thu Oct 12, 14:00–15:00 PDT and Wed Oct 11 fallback. I'll plan to bring the SI's infra diagram and be ready for deeper architecture Q&A.

One ask from the SI side: can the Redwood TL confirm if we'll show a cross-region failover during the demo (simulated traffic cutover)? If so, we'll need a quick prep run earlier that day (30 min) to validate the runbook steps.

Also, I've attached a short inventory of the SI's guest accounts and a link to add the SI engineer to the NebulaWorks calendar.

Cheers,
Lina
[Attachment: si-inventory.csv (CSV, 2 KB)]

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, lina@stratus-systems.com, amit@stratus-systems.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2028 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + Stratus joint demo — proposed windows

Thanks Lina / Amit — good to have you both.

Confirmed: I'm the Redwood technical lead for the session and we will demonstrate a controlled cross-region failover (simulated cutover) during the live demo. Vanessa, can your team run the 30-minute prep slot at 13:15–13:45 PDT on Thu Oct 12 to validate the KV-cache warmup and the traffic shift steps?

Kimberly, please stand by for the buyer's retention/SLA questions. I've updated the attached runbook with step numbers and fallbacks — see the bolded 'failover' section.

Sooj, once Lina confirms the guest accounts work, please send the calendar invite to NebulaWorks with the runbook attached and include the prep slot as an optional event. I'll be on the prep call and the main demo.

Karthik
